name: The Troll Cave
summary: In southern Coldridge Valley, Grelin Whitebeard sends you against Frostmane whelps settling in a cave. Their growing camp threatens nearby dwarven homesteads.

sections.title: Eyes in the Cold
sections.body: Grelin watches the frozen valley from a bluff as Ironforge's soldiers fight troggs across the snowfields. He and his brother Senir came on the mountain authorities' orders to learn whether the native ice trolls threatened the heartland. Now Grelin keeps watch alone, tracking their movements along the southern approaches.

sections.title: A Preemptive Strike
sections.body: Grelin found the local Frostmane clan settling in a deep cave along Coldridge Valley's southern ridge. He judges a full mobilization a waste of dwarven manpower, so he hires capable local volunteers to cull the aggressive whelps. Thinning the young fighters could disrupt the camp before the Frostmane launch coordinated raids against nearby dwarven homesteads.

faq.q: Why doesn't Ironforge send regular soldiers to deal with these trolls?
faq.answer: The Ironforge Senate and military are stretched thin by the sudden, devastating trogg invasion across Dun Morogh. Scouts like Grelin Whitebeard hire independent adventurers to handle smaller threats, including troll warbands.

The Frostmane are an indigenous tribe of ice trolls from Dun Morogh's frigid crags. They have long clashed with Bronzebeard dwarves and mountaineers over hunting grounds, territory, and ancient mountain passes.

faq.q: Where is the troll cave located?
faq.answer: The cave lies along the southern mountain ridge of Coldridge Valley, south of Grelin Whitebeard's observation camp.

Grelin Whitebeard is an Ironforge scout stationed in Coldridge Valley. His brother Senir surveys other parts of Dun Morogh, while Grelin tracks hostile troll populations and reports to dwarven leaders.

faq.q: Why does Grelin specifically target Frostmane whelps?
faq.answer: Grelin targets the Frostmane whelps because their settlement in southern Coldridge Valley is growing, with juvenile warriors among its members. Killing those young fighters may keep the band from growing strong enough to threaten dwarven supply lines.

faq.q: What happens after culling the cave?
faq.answer: After you cull the cave, the trolls retaliate at night. They raid Grelin's campsite and steal his personal field journal, which you must recover from deeper in their dens.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard dwarf, you face a threat to the frontier and an ancient mountain feud when you take up arms against Frostmane warbands.
As a gnome taking shelter in Dun Morogh after Gnomeregan's fall, you can lend your wits and weapons to help your dwarven hosts with threats around them.
As a hunter, you can use the crags around the southern cave as harsh proving grounds, flushing hostile quarry from the mountain heights.
